blue.name: Blue
blue.desc: No strengths, no weaknesses. The ink to learn with.

crimson.name: Crimson
crimson.desc: Enemies standing on your ink burn for 5 damage a second. You have 20% less health.

emerald.name: Emerald
emerald.desc: Your ink heals you for 1 health a second and slowly spreads on its own. Shots deal 10% less damage.

violet.name: Violet
violet.desc: Enemies on your ink are slowed by 15% and your Deluge reaches 20% further. Your fire rate is 10% lower.

gold.name: Gold
gold.desc: Gain 25% more XP and charge the Deluge 15% faster. Shots deal 15% less damage.
